Applicants wanting a small expressive touch
A few small colour dots decorate an otherwise restrained identity margin. Keep all career content on a plain white field with dark text and conventional, easily scanned section labels.
Rounded sans typography and soft blue section tabs create an approachable page. Use a quiet right rail and avoid enclosing every entry in a separate card.
Applicants who like warm optimistic design
A small amber identity accent and warm rounded headings give a sunny character. Use dark brown text, plenty of white space and no large coloured backgrounds behind career details.
A blocky monospace identity and tiny square section markers suggest pixel graphics. Keep the body in a normal readable sans serif and avoid bitmap text or a simulated game interface.
A light notebook-style margin, rounded identity and short blue rules support an approachable record. Keep ruled decoration outside the body text and make short resumes feel complete.
Pencil-like red underlines and a warm serif identity give a personal stationery feel. Keep every mark decorative and all qualifications in crisp, selectable type.
Small coloured section tabs organise two clear columns beneath a simple identity. Use colour as a secondary cue, with readable labels and a complete monochrome print treatment.
A compact plum identity, pale pink section strips and generous white space create a playful minimal page. Keep body text dark and avoid oversized rounded cards or decorative badges.
